summary: Confirmation + regression run for iter78 (Fitness Trends & Compare — Form Forecast, Weekly Digest, Segment Compare). Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter78_analysis_forecast_digest_segment.py with 9 pytest cases — ALL 9 PASS. Verified (1) GET /api/analysis/pmc?days=90&forecast_days=14 returns 90-day series + a 14-item forecast[] (each point has date/ctl/atl/tsb/tss/projected:true, strictly increasing dates, first date > last series date) plus forecast_fitness/forecast_form/forecast_state/projected_daily_tss and legacy fitness/fatigue/form/form_state/ramp_rate/weekly_tss; forecast_fitness matches fc[-1].ctl and forecast_form matches fc[-1].tsb. forecast_days=0 returns []; forecast_days=999 clamps to <=28. (2) GET /api/analysis/weekly-digest returns week_start + this_week{tss,hours,rides,distance_km} + deltas{tss,hours,rides,distance_km} + new_records[] + has_activity (bool consistent with rides>0); greenlantern (no activity) responds 200 with the same shape (no crash). (3) GET /api/analysis/segment-compare?a=e3cb783f...&b=c95da076... on demo returns matched:true with 1 segment gain_m in [130,220] (actual ~171), length_m in [2000,3200] (~2500), grad_pct present, a/b each with time_s>0 (10:13 vs 13:23 -> delta_s +190 -> faster='a'), and a.series/b.series each 51 points with f/d/ele/t/speed. (4) segment-compare graceful no-match: greenlantern GET returned matched:false with reason in {no_gps, no_shared_climb, not_found}; bogus ids returned same graceful shape — neither 500'd. Frontend: /fitness on demo shows the 'This Week your recap' Weekly Digest card with TSS(17)/Training time(0.3h)/Rides(1)/Distance(4.5km) tiles + '+X vs last wk' deltas, 'New power records' subsection, PmcSummary (Fitness/Fatigue/Form + Neutral state + ramp), Performance Management chart with the 'Projected' dashed legend item and 'last 90 days + 2-week forecast' subtitle, and an 'In 2 weeks' forecast summary card. /compare on demo lists both 'Col de Test' rides (pick-import-e3cb783f... and pick-import-c95da076...); selecting both and tapping mode-climb -> the segment-banner reads exactly 'Col de Test was 3:10 faster up this climb' and the segment-compare card renders with A/B legend, speed-up-the-climb chart with grey elevation area, CLIMB · 171m @ 6.7%, Time up climb 10:13 vs 13:23, Avg speed 15 vs 11.4, and 'Both rides aligned base-to-summit on the same GPS climb.' hint. Toggling back to mode-ride hides segment-banner and shows the whole-ride overlay card + METRIC delta table with Distance (km) and Moving time (min) rows populated. NOTE: Avg power / Norm. power / Avg HR / TSS rows are correctly HIDDEN in whole-ride mode because both Col de Test GPX rides have no power/HR data (UI shows 'These rides have no power data to compare.' — DeltaRow returns null when both sides are null, which is the intended behaviour). Everything works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/analysis.py::pmc — forecast projects the recent 14-day average daily TSS forward using the same CTL/ATL exp-smoothing kernels (42d / 7d) as the historical series. Correct TrainingPeaks-style continuation. forecast_days is clamped [0, 28] which matches the +/-28-day contract in the tests. forecast[0].date is guaranteed > last series date because it starts at today+1 while series ends at today.

routes/analysis.py::weekly_digest — this_week and last_week buckets both use half-open [lo, hi) intervals with wk_start=now-7d and prev_start=now-14d, so no ride is double-counted at the boundary. new_records logic correctly only surfaces a bucket when best_week[w].watts > best_before[w] (or when there is no prior record for that duration).

routes/analysis.py::segment_compare — graceful no-match paths are exhaustive: not_found (either ride missing), no_gps (<6 points on either track), no_shared_climb (empty pair list). Confirmed no code path can raise 500 on missing GPS.
segments.py::detect_climbs — uses _smooth_ele with window=3 and a 12m dip tolerance. min_gain=30m / min_grad=3% / min_len=400m thresholds correctly picked up the ~171m Col de Test climb.

segments.py::match_climbs — pairs by start-point haversine gap (<=300m) AND relative length delta (<=45%). Score = gap + lr*1000 favours identical starts. Symmetric enough that swapping a/b on the demo rides still matches the same climb.

frontend/app/compare.tsx::SegmentView — banner text 'Col de Test was 3:10 faster up this climb' is generated from mmss(abs(delta_s)) with faster='a'|'b'; delta_s +190s -> 3:10, correct. Tie path handled separately.

frontend/app/compare.tsx::DeltaRow — returns null when both values are missing. This correctly hides Avg power / Norm. power / Avg HR / TSS rows for the Col de Test GPX pair (no power/HR streams) — not a bug, matches the 'These rides have no power data to compare.' banner shown in the overlay card.

frontend/app/fitness.tsx — fetches PMC(90,14), records, and weekly-digest in parallel via Promise.all, single loading gate. ForecastSummary only renders when pmc.forecast.length > 0, so forecast_days=0 requests won't render an empty card.
